items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: No not Chano, it was somebody else. Anyways, I can't think of the guy’s name.

ctx.x: No not Chano, it was somebody else. Anyways, I can't think of the guy’s name. Joe Jones was the guy working with us. This was at The Roundtable. So, we had this guy up front on bongos, doing a solo. Joe was apparently playing too loud for him, so he stops the music and turns around to Joe and says (imitates a Portuguese accent) "Brushes, man! Use brushes, man!" (Laughs) it was in that accent. It was keep. It was funny.
What was the repertoire of Tyree Glenn?
